(1) popularity growth of videos in the top list is characterized by significant bursts, (2) popularity growth of copyright protected videos is characterized by a viral propagation process, (3) search is the most important referrer to videos in the top-lists, while other internal mechanisms are also important, and (4) external linking is an important source of traffic to copyright protected videos.
the popularity growth of videos is highly dependent on their content, the type of referrer, and their upload time.
the growth patterns of videos depend on their dataset and that search plays a key role in attracting users to all types of videos.
